name: How to Add Fillable Form Fields to a PDF Free
description: Click to place real text, checkbox, radio, and dropdown fields on a flat or scanned PDF — free, no upload, processed locally in your browser.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF form-field tool, no upload required

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. PDFree checks whether the document already has interactive fields — if it does, you're pointed to the Fill tool instead.

step.name: Click to place fields
step.text: Pick a field type — text, checkbox, radio, or dropdown — then click anywhere on the page to drop one there. Drag to reposition, drag the corner to resize, and type a name directly into the field. Repeat for every blank, on every page.

step.name: Download the fillable PDF
step.text: Click 'Add Fields & Download'. PDFree writes real AcroForm fields into the document in your browser and downloads the result immediately — no waiting, no account.
